Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

introducing my halloween baking series EPISODE 1: coraline button cookies 🪡🖤 i used @AngelSweets recipe with some personal tweaks!  1 cup of butter (2 sticks of unsalted) 1 cup of sugar 1 1/2 tsp of mexican vanilla extract 1 tsp of almond extract 3 cups of flour steps: *preheat oven to 350*  1. add room temperature butter and sugar into a large bowl and mix until everything is nice & fluffy.  2. add a room temperature egg + both extracts until both components are mixed fully into the dough.  3. slowly add in your flour (one cup at a time) until fully incorporated.  4. roll your dough into a ball & cut it into 4 pieces (one for each color) & fold each piece until you get your desired color.  5. roll your dough + place it into the fridge for 20 minutes 6. cut out your cookie, making sure to leave a smaller indent on each cookie to ensure a “button” look.  7. use whatever you have available (straw, cupcake decorator tip, etc) to create your button holes.  8. line a cookie tray with parchment paper & cook for around 8-12 mins. enjoy :) #coraline #buttoncookies #baking #halloweenbaking #fypシ

crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

Blueberry pull apart bread 🫐✨ Ingredients  Bread - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1/2 tsp salt Blueberry compote - 300g blueberries (about 2 cups) - 95g granulated sugar (10 tbsp + 2 tsp) - 1 tbsp lemon juice  - 12g cornstarch (cornstarch slurry) - 2 tbsp water (cornstarch slurry) Icing (didn’t measure) - Confectioners sugar - Melted butter - Whole milk - Splash of vanilla extract  - Splash of lemon extract  Instructions  Filling - In a medium sauce pan on medium heat combine blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice. Stir until well combined and cook until bubbling. - Add cornstarch slurry and stir constantly until very thick.  - Transfer into a heat safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cool for 10 minutes on the counter then refrigerate for 30-40 minutes. Bread - In a bowl, combine warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar. Sprinkle yeast over the top, stir lightly, and let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add eggs, 1/3 sugar, and mix again until well combined. - Add flour to mixture. Mix until a rough dough forms. - Begin kneading. Once the dough starts to come together, gradually add the softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), kneading until fully incorporated before adding more. - Continue kneading 8–10 minutes by hand or 5–6 minutes in a stand mixer, until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - Punch down dough and roll into a rectangle about 12x18 inches - Spread filling evenly across the surface - Cut into strips, then stack and cut again to fit upright into a greased loaf pan (1/2 pound loaf pan) - Cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes, until puffy. - Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes, tenting with foil if the top browns too quickly. - Top with icing and serve!  • • • #recipes #baking #springrecipes #bakingrecipe #recipeideas

One of my favorite soups, perfect for fall 🍂Loaded with Italian sausage, tender lasagna noodles, and all the cheesy goodness. The ultimate cozy comfort meal! Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio! 🤎 Lasagna soup Ingredients: 	⁃	1 small onion, diced 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Parsley 	⁃	Basil 	⁃	1 lb mild Italian sausage 	⁃	2 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	5 cups chicken stock 	⁃	24 oz marinara sauce 	⁃	1/4 tsp thyme 	⁃	1/2 tsp chili flakes 	⁃	1 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/2 tsp paprika  	⁃	1 tsp Italian seasoning 	⁃	1/2 tsp oregano 	⁃	1 tbsp tomato bullion 	⁃	Parmesan rind 	⁃	6-8 sheets lasagne noodles 	⁃	1/2 cup Parmesan 	⁃	1/3 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1/3 cup heavy cream Ricotta mixture 	⁃	1/3 cup ricotta 	⁃	1/4 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1 tbsp basil 	⁃	2 tbsp parsley 	⁃	1 tsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tsp garlic powder  	⁃	Salt and pepper to taste Instructions: Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Heat about 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent. Add the Italian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Stir in the tomato paste, chicken stock, marinara sauce, spices, and fresh basil. Mix well. Break the lasagna sheets into smaller pieces and add them to the pot, along with the Parmesan rind. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20–25 minutes, or until the lasagna noodles are tender. Remove the Parmesan rind, then stir in the Parmesan, mozzarella, and heavy cream. Simmer for another 5 minutes. Serve warm, topped with the ricotta mixture and fresh parsley. Enjoy! #lasaganasoup #soupseason #souprecipe #fall #fallrecipes

Nutella bombs ❤️💣  For everyone  asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search ‘Osta Recipes’ on the App Store or Google play store. Check it out!! 🫶🏻🤍 Servings: 6 buns Filling: 300g Nutella 1. Scoop 50g of Nutella on 6 separate pieces of parchment paper 2. Freeze until solid Dough: 130g warm water 2 eggs 1 egg yolk 55g melted unsalted butter 20g granulated sugar 7g instant yeast 1/2 tsp salt 345g all purpose flour 150g chocolate chips 1. In the bowl of your stand mixer fitted with a dough hook, whisk the warm water, sugar, yeast, melted butter, egg yolk and eggs 2. Add the flour and salt 3. Knead for 10-15 mins until a smooth dough forms. It’s okay if it’s still sticky /tacky. Just make sure it passes the window pane test. It has to stay sticky so the chocolate chips can stick :)  4. Form the dough into a ball and place in a large bowl. Cover with plastic film and proof for 2 hours 5. Preheat your oven to 350F and line a baking dish with some parchment paper 6. On a light floured surface, knead 150-200g of chocolate chips into the dough. 7. Don’t over knead, the chocolate will smudge. Mix until just combined 8. On a lightly floured surface, divide the dough into 6 pieces. Stuff each piece with the frozen Nutella then seal them shut 9. Top each bun with more chocolate chips Egg wash: - 2 egg yolks 1. Whisk 2 egg yolks until smooth 2. Brush the rolls 3. Bake in a preheated oven at 350F for 25 mins #bread #chocolatechip #baking brioche

Link in bio If you were to cut the loaf into 8 normal sized slices, macros would be… 105 Cals, 8.75g Net Carbs, 3g Fat, 13.25g Protein 105g protein for the loaf If you were to cut the loaf into 2 brownie bricks shown in video, macros would be… 421 Cals, 35g Net Carbs, 12g Fat, 53g Protein 105g protein for the loaf Crumbl brownie also has 1,270 cals and it’s half the size 🤯 ✳️ Wet Ingredients: 284g (1 1/4 Cup) Vanilla, Chocolate, or Plain Nonfat Greek Yogurt 60mL (1/4 Cup) Almond Milk 35g (2 1/2 tbsp) Light Butter, Softened 1 Medium Egg 👉 if batter is too thick, you may need to add more almond milk as I did in the video ✳️ Dry Ingredients: 45g (1/4 Cup + 2 tbsp) Oat Flour 12g (2 tbsp) All Purpose Flour 72g (1/2 Cup + 2 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute (I used Swerve) 2 Scoops Whey/Casein Blend Vanilla Protein Powder (@htltsupps code nickkaz saves $$) 25g (1/4 Cup + 1 tbsp) Black or Dark Cocoa Powder 4g (3/4 tsp) Baking Soda 2g (1/2 tsp) Baking Powder 👉 75% casein, 25% whey is ideal ✳️ Ingredients for McFlurry Frosting: 68g (1/4 Cup + 1 tbsp) Plain Nonfat Greek Yogurt 22g (2 1/2 tbsp) Light Cool Whip 24g (2 tbsp) Powdered Monk fruit/Sugar Substitute 1 Scoop Whey/Casein Blend Protein Powder (*optional - adds frosting thickness) 1 Oreo, crushed ✳️ Ingredients for Decoration (*optional*): 1 Oreo Balanced on Top for Decoration 1/4, Oreo, Thinly Crushed Small Streak of Black Icing 👉 Everything that is optional is NOT included in da macros ✳️ Directions: 1. Toffee brown butter chocolate chip cookies!  RECIPE Toffee: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 1 cup light brown sugar - Pinch of salt  Cookie dough:  - 2 cups all purpose flour - 1 1/2 tsp salt - 1 tsp baking soda - 1 cup unsalted butter, melted - 2 tbsp room temp water - 1 cup dark brown sugar  - 1/2 cup white sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/2 rounded tsp espresso powder  - 1 large egg - 1 egg yolk - 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chunks - 1/2 dark chocolate chunks  - 1 cup toffee bits 1. Make the toffee: combine butter and brown sugar in a saucepan. Place over medium heat. Allow butter to melt and whisk together to combine with the sugar. Bring to a bubble, whisking consistently. Use a candy thermometer and wait for the mixture to reach 300F (about 8 minutes) then remove from heat and pour onto a silicone or parchment lined baking sheet. Quickly spread the mixture out with a spatula to an smooth slab. Let cool for 20 minutes until hardened. Break toffee apart into small pieces as desired.   2. For the cookies: Melt butter in a saucepan and cook over a medium heat until the milk solids have browned and the butter is a nutty brown color. Transfer to a Pyrex cup, and add the water to make the liquids equal to 1 cup. Allow to cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.  3. In the meantime, in a small bowl mix together the flour, salt and baking soda. Set aside.  4. In a large bowl, combine the brown and white sugars with the brown butter, and whisk together vigorously to combine. Once homogenous, add the vanilla extract and espresso powder. Whisk to combine. Next, add the egg and egg yolk, whisk to combine.  5. Add the dry ingredients to the wet, and mix gently with a spatula to combine, stopping once you see no more streaks of flour and a dough has formed.  6. Add the chocolate and toffee bits and mix once more to combine.  7. Use a 3 tbsp cookie scoop to portion the cookie dough onto a lined plate or baking sheet. It should yield about 14 cookies. Cover and place in the freezer for at least 3 hours or overnight.  8. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 350F and bake cookies for 15 minutes. Once golden brown, remove from oven. Transfer to a cooling rack after 5 minutes and sprinkle with flakey salt. For misshapen cookies, use a round cup or bowl to gently reform into a circle. Allow to cool and enjoy! Tips: I like using a high quality baking sheet like @williamsonoma’s gold touch series to make sure cookies bake evenly and don’t spread too thin! I’ve been making this base recipe for years, adapted from an old @buzzfeedtasty recipe, and think the addition of toffee has made my favorite iteration yet!

Pot Roast Dinner 🥘 • • Ingredients: • 2.5 lb beef chuck roast • 4 carrots • 4 celery stalks • 1 yellow onion • 1 lb mini golden potatoes • 4 garlic cloves, minced • Salt, generous amount • Black pepper, generous amount • Garlic powder, generous amount • Smoked paprika, generous amount • Olive oil, for searing • 2 tbsp tomato paste • 1 tbsp beef bouillon base • 1½ cups dry red wine (I used Cabernet Sauvignon) • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 4¼ cups beef broth • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp all-purpose seasoning • 1 tsp blackened seasoning • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 pack beefy onion soup mix • 4 sprigs rosemary • 2 bay leaves • ¼ cup unsalted real butter Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. 2. Pat the chuck roast dry and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chuck roast on all sides until deeply browned, then remove and set aside. 4. Add the carrots, celery, and yellow onion to the same pot. Sauté for a few minutes, scraping the bottom of the pot to deglaze, add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 5. Add the tomato paste and beef bouillon base, stirring everything together. Pour in the wine and let it reduce by about 50%. 6. Add the flour and stir until well combined and thickened. Add the chuck roast back into the pot, then pour in the beef broth. 7. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, all-purpose seasoning, blackened seasoning, smoked paprika, beefy onion soup mix, rosemary, bay leaves, and butter. 8. Cover with the lid and bake at 350°F for 2 hours. After 2 hours, add the mini golden potatoes. Cover and return to the oven for 1 more hour. 9. After 3 hours, check that the roast is fork-tender and the potatoes are cooked through. 10. Remove the rosemary and bay leaves, then serve the tender pot roast with the vegetables, potatoes, and plenty of that rich gravy and enjoy :)  Comment “😍” if you would try this 👇🏽 #fyp #potroast #dinner #recipesoftiktok #macncheese

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor.
